Theorem
[Gallot--Meyer estimate (Theorem K.28)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0373 ↗ thm:chow-iv-k21-hodge-decomposition ↗ cor:chow-iv-k24-lowest-p-form-eigenvalue 1. appk:K.28\group Hodge Theory

If $(\mathcal M^n,g)$ is closed and the curvature operator satisfies $\lambda _1(\operatorname {Rm})\ge k>0$, then the first positive eigenvalue on $p$-forms obeys \[ \lambda _1^{[p]}(\mathcal M,g)\ge \min \{ p(n-p+1),(p+1)(n-p)\} \, k. \] This follows from the Bochner--Weitzenböck identity \[ \langle \Delta _d\alpha ,\alpha \rangle =\langle \Delta \alpha ,\alpha \rangle +\mathcal R_p(\alpha ,\alpha ) \] and $\mathcal R_p(\alpha ,\alpha )\ge p(n-p)k|\alpha |^2$.
